headline: Orserk attack boost
title: Orserk | Thunder Dragon That Buffs Your Pal | Palworld Guide
video_script: Want a stronger team in Palworld one point zero? Orserk lives inside the World Tree at roughly level seventy four to eighty. Its partner skill, Ferocious Thunder Dragon, makes every bullet hit boost the attack and defense of the Pal fighting beside you by one to five percent, stacking up to thirty times. At base it hits Generating Electricity level eight. Will you hunt Orserk? Comment below!
description: Orserk in Palworld 1.0 lives in the World Tree, buffs your fighting Pal with bullet hits and generates electricity at level eight.
